The hotel base is $765 for three nights. Its quoted total with tax is $885.49, so lodging tax and fees account for $120.49. Adding the $548 airfare brings the confirmed travel charges to $1,433.49 before ground transportation.
What are you carrying for ground transportation?

The working estimate is $22 for round-trip airport rail and $56 for local transportation during the visit, or $78 total. That produces an estimated trip total of $1,511.49, leaving $8.51 under the authorization.
That is very tight. Does the hotel breakfast reduce any separate meal estimate in that number?

There is no meal allowance included in the $1,511.49 calculation. Breakfast for one is included in the hotel rate, but any other reimbursable meals would sit outside this travel total unless the project authorization is meant to cover them too.
The $1,520 is airfare, hotel, and transportation only, so that’s fine. Confirm the actual schedule around the meetings.

The Tuesday nonstop arrives in Denver early enough for hotel check-in that evening and leaves the full Wednesday morning available before the client work begins. On Friday, the meeting ends at 3:30 p.m.; the selected evening nonstop allows just over two hours from the meeting site to scheduled departure. With the hotel near Union Station and rail access to the airport, that is workable, though there is not much room for a long wrap-up.

The $548 airfare is the current quoted total for the Tuesday and Friday nonstops. It is not refundable; changes are permitted subject to any fare difference. The quote expires this evening and must be repriced if it is not ticketed by then. The Hotel Indigo total is $885.49 including tax and breakfast for one. It can be canceled without penalty until 6:00 p.m. Denver time on Sunday, January 10; after that, the penalty is one night’s room and tax.
Please give me the final booking-ready breakdown, and flag anything that could push it over.

Booking-ready estimate: airfare $548.00; Hotel Indigo, three nights January 12-15, $885.49 including tax; airport rail $22.00 estimated; local transportation $56.00 estimated. Total: $1,511.49, which is $8.51 below the $1,520 authorization. The itinerary qualifies as priced, but any airfare increase or more than $8.51 in additional transportation would exceed the limit.
Good. Keep it ready, but don’t purchase until I send the final approval this afternoon.

The January 12-15 Denver itinerary is prepared for booking with the Tuesday evening nonstop, Friday evening return, and Hotel Indigo stay. I have not purchased or reserved anything. The airfare must be rechecked before approval because the $548 quote expires this evening; the hotel rate, availability, and cancellation terms should be reconfirmed at the same time.
